preApplyChecks.ledgerReconciliation: The ledger holds exactly the 13 recovered versions (the 20260728213131 remote baseline, 20260818200000 through 20260819120000, and 20260823171000). 20260822180000 has no ledger row and its object is absent in Production; it is outside this chain and is not replayed. The three 2026-08-25 Clinic files have no ledger rows and their objects are present. All ten chain signatures are absent, so every file is applied on its object state, none on a ledger gap alone.

preApplyChecks.existingRowEffect: 43 stored pending results: 28 claimed under the old scheme gain their unique Briefcase matter link and become CLAIMED; 15 unclaimed rows that carry no claim token and are already past expires_at become REVOKED (0 unexpired, 0 created in the last 24 hours, 0 claimed without a provable matter); no row is deleted and no live pending row exists.

acceptedRevocation.basis: Counts read back without writing by run 35129903710; the migrate phase re-reads them and refuses before any write if a bucket exceeds its maximum. The expired, tokenless, ownerless rows were already unclaimable under both schemes.
